reden: The described issue is an off-by-one inequality in VotingEscrow._withdraw’s time check (>= vs > or <= vs <). The audit report’s related item concerns unlock() being publicly callable, which sets unlocked=true and makes _withdraw skip the time check entirely. That is an access-control/logic flaw, not a boundary off-by-one in _withdraw. Fixing one would not fix the other, so the report did not detect the described vulnerability.
